title: Initial Access via Path Traversal Exploit in SysAid Tomcat
id: 2ff912e8-159f-4789-a2ef-761292b32a24
status: experimental
description: Detects upload of a WAR archive containing a WebShell to the webroot directory of SysAid Tomcat, exploiting a path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) in the /usersfiles endpoint. This indicates initial access via drive-by compromise.
references:
    - https://www.sysaid.com/blog/service-desk/on-premise-software-security-vulnerability-notification
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1189/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-15
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1189
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1505.003
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1203
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection:
        cs-uri-query|contains: '/usersfiles'
        cs-method: 'POST'
        sc-status: 200
        cs-user-agent|contains:
            - 'usersfiles.war'
            - '.war'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative uploads to the usersfiles endpoint
level: high

title: Execution of GraceWire Loader via WebShell Deployment
id: 2ff912e8-159f-4789-a2ef-761292b32a25

references:
    - https://www.sysaid.com/blog/service-desk/on-premise-software-security-vulnerability-notification
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/

    - attack.defense-evasion
    - attack.t1059.001

    category: process_creation
    product: windows

    selection:
